function take_buff_info(tab)
	local icon_buff = ""
	local time_buff = ""
	local final_buff = ""
	local icon_debuff = ""
	local time_debuff = ""
	local final_debuff = ""
	--local debug_text = ""
	if HaveMagic(1976)>0 then
		icon_buff = icon_buff.."<pic="..(icon[1976][1]-1).."> "
		time_buff = time_buff..GetTask(5124).." Né " --GetSkillName(tab[1][i])
	end
	if HaveMagic(1883)>0 then
		icon_buff = icon_buff.."<pic="..(icon[1883][1]-1).."> "
		time_buff = time_buff..GetTask(5124).." ¢m " --GetSkillName(tab[1][i])
	end
	if tab[1] and type(tab[1]) == "table" and getn(tab[1])>=1 then 
		for i = 1, getn(tab[1]) do
			--debug_text=debug_text.." "..tab[1][i]
			if icon[tab[1][i]] then
				local nLeftTime = ceil(tab[2][i]/18)
				local nHourMinute = floor(nLeftTime / 60)
				local nSec = mod(nLeftTime, 60)
				local nHour = floor(nHourMinute/60)
				local nMinute = mod(nHourMinute, 60)
				local nDay = floor(nHour/24)
				if icon[tab[1][i]][2] == 1 then
					icon_buff = icon_buff.."<pic="..(icon[tab[1][i]][1]-1).."> "
					if nHourMinute < 1 then
						if nSec >= 10 then
							time_buff = time_buff..nSec.."s  "
						elseif nSec==1 then
							time_buff = time_buff.."N/A  "
						else
							time_buff = time_buff.." "..nSec.."s  " 
						end
					elseif nHour < 1 then
						if nMinute >= 10 then
							time_buff = time_buff..nMinute.."M  "
						else
							time_buff = time_buff.." "..nMinute.."M  "
						end
					
					elseif nDay >=1 then
						if nDay >= 100 then
							time_buff = time_buff..nDay.."d "
						elseif nDay >= 10 then
							time_buff = time_buff..nDay.."d  "
						else
							time_buff = time_buff.." "..nDay.."d  "
						end
					else
					         	if nHour >= 10 then
							time_buff = time_buff..nHour.."h  "
						else
							time_buff = time_buff.." "..nHour.."h  "
						end    
					end
				else
					icon_debuff = icon_debuff.."<pic="..(icon[tab[1][i]][1]-1).."> "
					if nHourMinute < 1 then
						if nSec >= 10 then
							time_debuff = time_debuff..nSec.."s  " 
						else
							time_debuff = time_debuff.." "..nSec.."s  " 
						end
					elseif nHour < 1 then
						if nMinute >= 10 then
							time_debuff = time_debuff..nMinute.."M  "
						else
							time_debuff = time_debuff.." "..nMinute.."M  "
						end
					else
					         	if nHour >= 10 then
							time_debuff = time_debuff..nHour.."h  "
						else
							time_debuff = time_debuff.." "..nHour.."h  "
						end   
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	--Msg2Player(debug_text)
	final_buff = icon_buff.."\n"..time_buff
	final_debuff = icon_debuff.."\n"..time_debuff
	return final_buff, final_debuff
end


function open_miniskill(tab)
	local final_buff, final_debuff = take_buff_info(tab)
	OpenBattleSelect()
	SetBattleSelectInfo(2, final_buff)
	SetBattleSelectInfo(3, final_debuff)	
end

    local f = openfile(".\\logs\\expranking.txt", "w")
    if f then
        write(f, data)
        closefile(f)
        Msg2Player("Cap nhat du lieu xep hang thanh cong!")
    else
        Msg2Player("Cap nhat du lieu xep hang that bai!")
    end
end
